source.text: הַ֥לְלוּ יָ֨הּ׀הַֽלְלוּ־אֵ֥ל בְּקָדְשׁ֑וֹ הַֽ֝לְל֗וּהוּ בִּרְקִ֥יעַ עֻזּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Praise Yah! Praise God in his holy place; praise him in [the] expanse of his strength.

en.L: Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}! Praise God in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} sanctuary; praise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} in the expanse of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} strength!
en.B: Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}! Praise God in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy place; praise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} in the great expanse of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} power!
en.R: Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}! Praise God in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy place! Praise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} in the mighty sky that shows {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} power!

fr.L: Louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} ! Louez Dieu dans {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} sanctuaire ; louez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} dans l’étendue de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} force !
fr.B: Louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} ! Louez Dieu dans {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} lieu saint ; louez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} dans la vaste étendue de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} puissance !
fr.R: Louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} ! Louez Dieu dans {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} lieu saint ! Louez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} dans le ciel immense qui montre {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} puissance !

sw.L: Msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}! Msifuni Mungu katika mahali {{deity_pronoun:pake|Pake}} patakatifu; msifuni katika anga la nguvu {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}!
sw.B: Msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}! Msifuni Mungu mahali {{deity_pronoun:pake|Pake}} patakatifu; msifuni katika anga kubwa la uweza {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}!
sw.R: Msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}! Msifuni Mungu mahali {{deity_pronoun:pake|Pake}} patakatifu! Msifuni katika anga kuu linaloonyesha uweza {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}!

es.L: ¡{{plural_you:Alaben|Alabad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yah}}! {{plural_you:Alaben|Alabad}} a Dios en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} santuario; ¡{{plural_you:alábenlo|alabadlo}} en el firmamento de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} poder!
es.B: ¡{{plural_you:Alaben|Alabad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yah}}! {{plural_you:Alaben|Alabad}} a Dios en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} lugar santo; ¡{{plural_you:alábenlo|alabadlo}} en la gran bóveda de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} poder!
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Alaben|Alabad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yah}}! ¡{{plural_you:Alaben|Alabad}} a Dios en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} lugar santo! ¡{{plural_you:Alábenlo|Alabadlo}} en el cielo inmenso que muestra {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} poder!

decisions.choice: Praise Yah: hallelu-yah, a call to praise the LORD
decisions.reason: The words (hallelu yah) are a command to a group, "praise Yah"; Yah is the short form of the divine name (YHWH). Psalms 146-150 each open and close with this call. Here in Psalm 150 the renderings translate it, as "Praise the LORD", rather than keep it as the borrowed word "Hallelujah".

decisions.choice: Psalm 150: the end of Book Five and of the Psalms
decisions.reason: Each of the first four books of Psalms ends with a blessing of God (41:14; 72:18-19; 89:53; 106:48). Psalm 150, a call to praise from beginning to end, closes Book Five and the whole book. The Psalms began with the blessed person (1:1) and end with everything that breathes praising God (150:6).

decisions.choice: his holy place: his sanctuary, in heaven or on earth
decisions.reason: The word (qodesh) is holiness and also the holy place, the temple. Set beside the sky in the second line, it may be God's heavenly dwelling, or the temple where the instruments of verses 3-5 were played.

decisions.choice: the expanse: the dome of the sky
decisions.reason: The word (raqia') is the expanse God made in Genesis 1:6-8, the sky that tells of his glory (19:2). "Of his strength" says it shows his power.

decisions.choice: the mighty sky that shows his power
decisions.reason: Readable says how the sky is "of his strength" (m4).

records.literal_gloss: Praise him for his mighty deeds; praise him according to [the] abundance of his greatness.

en.L: Praise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} mighty deeds; praise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} according to the abundance of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} greatness!
en.B: Praise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} for the mighty things {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has done; praise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} as fits {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} boundless greatness!
en.R: Praise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} for the powerful things {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has done! Praise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} because {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is so very great!

fr.L: Louez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} pour {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} hauts faits ; louez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} selon l’abondance de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} grandeur !
fr.B: Louez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} pour les actes puissants qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a accomplis ; louez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} comme le mérite {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} grandeur sans limite !
fr.R: Louez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} pour les choses puissantes qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a faites ! Louez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} parce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est si grand !

sw.L: Msifuni kwa ajili ya matendo {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} ya uweza; msifuni kulingana na ukuu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mwingi!
sw.B: Msifuni kwa mambo makuu aliyoyatenda; msifuni kama inavyostahili ukuu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usio na mpaka!
sw.R: Msifuni kwa mambo yenye nguvu aliyoyatenda! Msifuni kwa sababu {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ni mkuu mno!

es.L: {{plural_you:Alábenlo|Alabadlo}} por {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} hechos poderosos; ¡{{plural_you:alábenlo|alabadlo}} conforme a la abundancia de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} grandeza!
es.B: {{plural_you:Alábenlo|Alabadlo}} por las cosas poderosas que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha hecho; ¡{{plural_you:alábenlo|alabadlo}} como merece {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} grandeza sin límites!
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Alábenlo|Alabadlo}} por las cosas poderosas que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha hecho! ¡{{plural_you:Alábenlo|Alabadlo}} porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} es grandísimo!

decisions.choice: according to the abundance: as his greatness deserves
decisions.reason: Praise is to match how great he is, so it can never be too much.

source.text: הַֽ֭לְלוּהוּ בְּתֵ֣קַע שׁוֹפָ֑ר הַֽ֝לְל֗וּהוּ בְּנֵ֣בֶל וְכִנּֽוֹר׃

records.literal_gloss: Praise him with [the] blast of [the] ram's horn; praise him with harp and lyre.

en.L: Praise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} with the blast of the ram's horn; praise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} with harp and lyre!
en.B: Praise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} with the ram's horn blast; praise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} with harp and lyre!
en.R: Praise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} by blowing the ram's horn! Praise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} by playing harps and lyres!

fr.L: Louez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} au son de la corne de bélier ; louez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} avec harpe et lyre !
fr.B: Louez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} en sonnant de la corne de bélier ; louez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} avec la harpe et la lyre !
fr.R: Louez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} en soufflant dans la corne de bélier ! Louez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} en jouant de la harpe et de la lyre !

sw.L: Msifuni kwa mlio wa pembe ya kondoo dume; msifuni kwa zeze na kinubi!
sw.B: Msifuni kwa sauti ya pembe ya kondoo dume; msifuni kwa zeze na kinubi!
sw.R: Msifuni kwa kupiga pembe ya kondoo dume! Msifuni kwa kupiga zeze na vinubi!

es.L: {{plural_you:Alábenlo|Alabadlo}} con el toque del cuerno de carnero; ¡{{plural_you:alábenlo|alabadlo}} con arpa y lira!
es.B: {{plural_you:Alábenlo|Alabadlo}} con el sonido del cuerno de carnero; ¡{{plural_you:alábenlo|alabadlo}} con arpa y lira!
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Alábenlo|Alabadlo}} tocando el cuerno de carnero! ¡{{plural_you:Alábenlo|Alabadlo}} tocando arpas y liras!

decisions.reason: The shofar, a ram's horn, was blown to call the people, at festivals and in war (Leviticus 25:9; Joshua 6:4; 2 Samuel 6:15).

decisions.choice: harp and lyre: stringed instruments of the temple
decisions.reason: The nevel and the kinnor were the stringed instruments the Levites played in worship (1 Chronicles 15:16; 25:1). Their exact shapes are not certain; the nevel was probably the larger.
Verses 3-5 name the instruments of Israel's worship, wind, strings and percussion, with dancing: every kind of music is called into praise (1 Chronicles 15:28; 2 Chronicles 5:12-13).

decisions.choice: "la corne de bélier" for the shofar
decisions.reason: The shofar is a ram's horn blown like a trumpet, as the meaning decision says. French names what it is, as the English does, rather than "trompette", which is a metal instrument.

decisions.choice: "zeze" for the harp (nevel) and "kinubi" for the lyre (kinnor)
decisions.reason: Both are plucked stringed instruments. Swahili names two kinds, "zeze" and "kinubi", so that the verse still lists two instruments, as the Hebrew does; "kinubi" is the word used for the lyre throughout these psalms.

source.text: הַֽ֭לְלוּהוּ בְתֹ֣ף וּמָח֑וֹל הַֽ֝לְל֗וּהוּ בְּמִנִּ֥ים וְעוּגָֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: Praise him with tambourine and dancing; praise him with strings and pipe.

en.L: Praise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} with tambourine and dancing; praise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} with stringed instruments and flute!
en.B: Praise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} with hand drum and dance; praise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} on strings and pipes!
en.R: Dance and play tambourines to praise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}! Play stringed instruments and flutes to praise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}!

fr.L: Louez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} avec tambourin et danse ; louez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} avec instruments à cordes et flûte !
fr.B: Louez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} avec le tambour et la danse ; louez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} sur les cordes et les flûtes !
fr.R: Dansez et jouez du tambourin pour {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} louer ! Jouez des instruments à cordes et de la flûte pour {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} louer !

sw.L: Msifuni kwa matari na kucheza; msifuni kwa ala za nyuzi na filimbi!
sw.B: Msifuni kwa kigoma cha mkono na kucheza; msifuni kwa nyuzi na mazomari!
sw.R: Chezeni na kupiga matari ili kumsifu! Pigeni ala za nyuzi na filimbi ili kumsifu!

es.L: {{plural_you:Alábenlo|Alabadlo}} con pandero y danza; ¡{{plural_you:alábenlo|alabadlo}} con instrumentos de cuerda y flauta!
es.B: {{plural_you:Alábenlo|Alabadlo}} con tambor y danza; ¡{{plural_you:alábenlo|alabadlo}} con cuerdas y flautas!
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Bailen|Bailad}} y {{plural_you:toquen|tocad}} panderos para alabarlo! ¡{{plural_you:Toquen|Tocad}} instrumentos de cuerda y flautas para alabarlo!

decisions.reason: The word (minnim) is strings, and so instruments played on strings (45:9).
The 'ugav, first named in Genesis 4:21, was probably a pipe or flute.

records.literal_gloss: Praise him with cymbals of sound; praise him with cymbals of shouting.

en.L: Praise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} with cymbals of sound; praise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} with cymbals of [the] shout!
en.B: Praise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} with clear-sounding cymbals; praise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} with cymbals that ring out like a shout!
en.R: Praise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} with cymbals that ring! Praise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} with cymbals that crash loudly!

fr.L: Louez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} avec des cymbales de son ; louez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} avec des cymbales d’acclamation !
fr.B: Louez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} avec des cymbales sonores ; louez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} avec des cymbales qui retentissent comme un cri de joie !
fr.R: Louez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} avec des cymbales qui sonnent ! Louez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} avec des cymbales qui éclatent bien fort !

sw.L: Msifuni kwa matoazi ya sauti; msifuni kwa matoazi ya shangwe!
sw.B: Msifuni kwa matoazi yenye sauti safi; msifuni kwa matoazi yanayolia kama kelele za shangwe!
sw.R: Msifuni kwa matoazi yanayolia! Msifuni kwa matoazi yanayogongana kwa sauti kubwa!

es.L: {{plural_you:Alábenlo|Alabadlo}} con címbalos sonoros; ¡{{plural_you:alábenlo|alabadlo}} con címbalos de júbilo!
es.B: {{plural_you:Alábenlo|Alabadlo}} con címbalos de sonido claro; ¡{{plural_you:alábenlo|alabadlo}} con címbalos que resuenan como un grito!
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Alábenlo|Alabadlo}} con címbalos que suenan! ¡{{plural_you:Alábenlo|Alabadlo}} con címbalos que retumban con fuerza!

decisions.choice: cymbals of sound, cymbals of shouting: two ways of playing
decisions.reason: The cymbals were played by the Levites (1 Chronicles 15:16, 19). The two phrases may name two kinds of cymbals, or the ringing and the loud clash of the same ones.
The word (teru'ah) is a loud shout or blast, of joy or of battle (33:3; 47:6).

records.literal_gloss: All the breath, let it praise Yah. Praise Yah!

en.L: Let all that breathes praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}! Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}!
en.B: Let every creature that breathes praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}! Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}!
en.R: Every living thing that breathes, praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}! Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}!

fr.L: Que tout ce qui respire loue {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} ! Louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} !
fr.B: Que toute créature qui respire loue {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} ! Louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} !
fr.R: Vous tous, êtres vivants qui respirez, louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} ! Louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} !

sw.L: Vyote vyenye pumzi na vimsifu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}! Msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}!
sw.B: Kila kiumbe kinachopumua na kimsifu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}! Msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}!
sw.R: Kila kiumbe hai kinachopumua, msifu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}! Msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}!

es.L: ¡Que todo lo que respira alabe {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yah}}! ¡{{plural_you:Alaben|Alabad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yah}}!
es.B: ¡Que toda criatura que respira alabe {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yah}}! ¡{{plural_you:Alaben|Alabad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yah}}!
es.R: Todo ser vivo que respira, ¡{{plural_you:alaben|alabad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yah}}! ¡{{plural_you:Alaben|Alabad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yah}}!

decisions.reason: The word (neshamah) is the breath of life God breathed into the first human (Genesis 2:7), and "all that has breath" can mean every living creature (Genesis 7:22) or all people (Joshua 10:40). The psalm, which has called on angels, creation and every people, ends by calling on all that lives.

decisions.choice: the last words of the Psalms
decisions.reason: The book of Psalms ends with the call "Praise Yah!", the word with which each of its last five psalms begins and ends.
